quests.title: Welcome to Modern Industrialization
quests.desc:
&#A0DE45&nModern Industrialization&r is a mod which is similar to &#D93D3DIC2&r and &#D93D3DGregTech&r in its nature but you must progress differently than those 2 mods.

Through these quests, I will guide you to making parts required for the &#E8C843AllTheMods Star&r and later on &#43E898Infinity Armor&r.

quests.title: Forge Hammer
quests.desc:
&#6E6D6D&nForge Hammer&r is the beginning of your journey. It has a lot of uses like getting a &#B53A3Abetter output&r out of your ores to making &#DBD25Acomponents&r for future crafts.

The &7Hammer&r you crafted is not required for a recipe but it will give you a better output on the &#DBD25Acomponents&r you craft.

quests.title: Villager Trades
quests.desc: The &#6E6D6DForge Hammer&r acts as the workstation block for the &#A0DE45Modern Industrialization&r villager. This villager will give you a wide variety of useful trades.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
The &#DBA15ASteam Drill&r will be your best friend for early game mining. It is able to do a &53 by 3&r mining area as well as have a &#EEF768toggle-able silk touch&r.

You can toggle &53 by 3&r mining by pressing the keybind "Toggle 3x3 Mining" which is default set to &7'Y'&r.

&#EEF768Silk Touch&r can be toggled by &7Sneak Right-Clicking&r the Steam Drill

To fill the &#DBA15ASteam Drill&r, you can hold the drill over a &6fuel&r in your inventory and &7Right-Click&r. &9Water&r can be either &7Right-Clicked&r in world or you can carry a water bucket around.

quests.title: Мідний пил
quests.desc: The &#6E6D6DForge Hammer&r will allow you to easily crush &#FFAC3BCopper&r Ingots or Ore forms into its Dusts.

quests.title: Олов'яний пил
quests.desc: The &#6E6D6DForge Hammer&r will allow you to easily crush &#9AD5EDTin&r Ingots or Ore forms into its Dusts.

quests.title: Bronze
quests.desc: &#ED9553Bronze&r will act as the building block of the &7&nSteam Age&r. Cooking this dust will get you the &#ED9553Bronze Ingots&r we'll further use.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
&#ED9553Bronze Boiler&r converts &9water&r into steam. Steam will act as fuel for your machines to work in the &7&nSteam Age&r.

To use the machine, simply provide it with &9water&r and any &#ED5353furnace fuel&r. This will raise the temperature of the machine, at maximum temperature it will be able to handle 4 machines simultaneously.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: The &#EDD653&nCompressor&r is used to make &#53EDAAPlates&r, &#53EDAACurved Plates&r and &#53EDAARings&r.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: The &#EDD653&nMixer&r will allow us to combine items and fluids. They can be used to dye items or even duplicate them.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: The &#E3BC19Bronze Furnace&r acts just like a regular one, only major difference is it runs on steam and is twice as fast.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
The &#EDD653&nCutting Machine&r enables you to do a lot of crafts. The important ones are the Bolts. 

&#EDD653&nCutting machine&r works with &#E3993DLubricant&r which is obtained by using the &#EDD653&nMixer&r.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
The &7&nCoke Oven&r will be used to convert &#787777Coal&r to &#696464Coke&r. &#696464Coke&r is 4 times as effective as a fuel than &#787777Coal&r. 

The multiblock can be previewed by holding a &#D1D15Ewrench&r in your off or main hand. Holding &#B4D95Dhatches&r in your hand will tell you the possible positions for them.

The &7&nCoke Oven&r is a hollow multiblock made up of mostly bricks.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
The &#EDD653&nSteam Blast Furnace&r unlocks new horizons of progression. This will be a key multiblock in your future endeavours.

Not only will this multiblock allow you to make &7Steel Ingots&r but also it allows processing of &#696E60Raw Synthetic Oil&r to &#494D43Synthetic Oil&r which will be used later for &#36472ARubber&r and more things.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: Combining the Coke dust with Iron will give Uncooked Steel Dust. Cooking it in the Steam Blast Furnace will yield you Steel Ingots required for future progression.

quests.title: Multiblock Levels
quests.desc: All &cmultiblocks&r are defined by the &ehatches&r put in them. Upgrading these &ehatches&r in the &cmultiblocks&r will upgrade the machine as a whole.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: The &#65C2A6Wiremill&r is able to apply just the right amount of force to make &#53E67BWires&r for us. Shocking!! I know...

quests.title: Steel Age
quests.desc: Steel Machines use twice as much steam as the Bronze ones but they also make up for it with the twice the speed increase.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: The &#65C2A6Alloy Smelter&r comes from &#3187C4Extended Industrialization&r. It combines the task of &#4C4BDEMixer&r and &#954BDEFurnace&r into one, hence making the job less tedious.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: The &#65C2A6Packer&r is used to create &#53E67BDouble Ingots&r, &#53E67BBlades&r and &#53E67BCables&r. Along with this there are many other uses for the machine but these will be the main ones for you.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
The &#65C2A6Unpacker&r has a lot of uses from being able to unpack &#53E67BBlock into Ingots&r and more to &#53E67Brecycling parts&r of machines.

&oYou can even get easier Silicon Ingots from it.&r

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc:
The &#65C2A6Quarry&r is a multiblock to generate resources. It requires &aDrills&r and &7Steam&r to function.

Every iteration has a chance of consuming the &aDrill&r. Better &aDrills&r give better resources.

Steam Quarry can only use &#DEA14BCopper&r and &#DE9531Bronze Drills&r. It can also use &#8A5C1EDirt&r to generate Stones.

quests.title: Dire Wire
quests.desc: Using the newly constructed &#65C2A6Wiremill&r, we can now make &#53E67BWires&r and &#53E67BFine Wires&r which will lead us into electrics.

quests.title: Rubber and Circuit Board
quests.desc: Production of &7Rubber&r for your move into &#C1DB46&nThe Electric Age&r is trivial. Automating it at the earliest will take you further than you believe.

quests.title: Capacitance and Resistance
quests.desc: A &#46DBBBCircuit&r will require some of these basic components to function, automating parts of these will be useful in the future.

quests.title: Відсутній предмет
quests.desc: The &#467FDB&nAnalog Circuit&r, ah! you finally made it. Usually other people took half as much time as you but I won't hold this against you...
